card.name: Capitalized articles in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Mostly the word A or THE in all-caps label text, right before a noun phrase such as a history, a poison control center or the risk. Also fires on endings of long capitalized drug or condition words.

modes.label: Capital A / THE
modes.description: The article A or THE in all-caps warning text, just before a noun.
modes.example: SEEK PROFESSIONAL ASSISTANCE OR CONTACT<< A>> POISON CONTROL CENTER IMMEDIATELY

modes.label: Ends of capitalized medical words
modes.description: Closing piece of an all-caps drug or condition name.
modes.example: SERIOUS ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY REQUIRE TREATMENT WITH EPINEPHR<<INE>> AND OTHER EMERGENCY MEASURES

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the letter a and similar article-like tokens, with Chinese words for 'a/some' also suppressed.
card.plain: It marks all-caps warning text where an article like A or THE has just appeared, or where a long capitalized drug name ends.
